ui.system_welcome_title: Welcome to the Creative Discussion Platform
ui.system_welcome_content: This is an "AI Multi-Agent Discussion Framework" system designed to help users quickly generate innovative ideas through role-based dialogues, sparking more creativity!
ui.system_role_content:
You will see two AI agents participating in the discussion with different professional backgrounds:
The Businessman focuses on "Can this sell?" and "Is it attractive?",
while the Engineer focuses on "Can this be done?" and "Is the technology too difficult?".
ui.system_ai_feedback_content: You can choose whether to enable the two agents to provide peer feedback to each other's viewpoints. This setting allows them to engage in deeper extensions and dialogues about your ideas, stimulating more inspiration! You can also specify that only one of the agents participates in the response based on the discussion context.
ui.system_saved_ideas_content: Do you like any ideas that come up during the interaction with the agents? You can check to save them for later discussion!
ui.system_free_input_content: You can freely input your ideas, just like interacting with ChatGPT, and the agents will continue to discuss with you based on your thoughts.
ui.system_scamper_input_content: You can choose a creative thinking technique (SCAMPER) to extend your selected idea, such as Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to another use, Eliminate, and Reverse.
ui.system_locked: Discussion has started. Settings are locked.
ui.usage_guide_content:
This is a creative brainstorming tool that combines LLM and multi-agent discussion to help you explore different perspectives and stimulate inspiration!

### How to Use?
- Provide your ideas for each round
- AI agents give feedback and extended ideas from different angles
- Save the ideas you like and continue the discussion, or take the lead with your own ideas
ui.round_start_display: Please provide creative ideas related to "{question}" with a brief description of their use.
ui.removed_saved_ideas: 🗑️ 已移除 {count} 個收藏的 Idea

substitute.label: SCAMPER - Substitute
substitute.description: Replace a part with a different material or method.
substitute.example: For example: Substitute the potato with sweet potato to make "sweet potato fries".

combine.label: SCAMPER - Combine
combine.description: Merge two products or functions into one.
combine.example: For example: Combine headphones and a hat to create a hat with built-in Bluetooth headphones.

adapt.label: SCAMPER - Adapt
adapt.description: Apply a feature from one product to another.
adapt.example: For example: Adapt the design of running shoes for office slippers to provide support and comfort for those who stand for long periods.

modify.label: SCAMPER - Modify
modify.description: Change size, shape, or appearance to improve appeal.
modify.example: For example: Modify a hamburger by making it smaller into a mini burger, perfect for party snacks!

put_to_use.label: SCAMPER - Put to another use
put_to_use.description: Use something for a completely different purpose.
put_to_use.example: For example: Use an old suitcase as a pet bed, recycling it!

eliminate.label: SCAMPER - Eliminate
eliminate.example: For example: Remove the physical buttons from a phone and switch to touch controls.

reverse.label: SCAMPER - Reverse
reverse.description: Reverse roles or order to create new ideas.
reverse.example: For example: Reverse the traditional pizza by putting the toppings inside the crust to create a "stuffed pizza".
